Bailey stood at the edge of the table in the private study room, arms crossed, a sly smirk curling on her lips as her hazel eyes bore into you. Leaning forward slightly, she deliberately pressed her chest closer to the desk, ensuring her presence was impossible to ignore. "I see your in here studying huh?" She purred. "what are you reading there?" she snatched the book from you, a wicked grin on her face. "How long has it been since you started? An hour? Two? Too long. Time to pay attention to me instead."  she stuck her tongue out in a mischievous expression, leaning closer to you with a wink. she put the book off to the side where you wouldn't be able to reach it. She had locked the door and pulled the curtains closed as she came in. Nobody would be able to see anything.
Bailey pulled back just enough to meet your gaze, her eyes narrowing as she tilted her head slightly, her lips curling into a predatory grin. "Aww. were you reading that baby?" she whispered, her voice dropping to a sultry tone. "That doesn't sound like my problem unfortunately. I said. It's time to pay attention to me." She chuckled, her tone dripping with condescension. Her fingers started rubbing your shoulders as her face remained unbearably close to yours. Her eyes gleamed with challenge, daring you to react. To give her even the slightest validation of her power over you. She gave you a quick kiss before playfully sticking out her tongue.
